name: Business Services Inbound Calls

hero.headline: Business Services Inbound Calls
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for business services solutions.

overview: Business Services Inbound Calls are consumers who see an offer and dial in themselves, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Deliver B2B leads and calls from business owners seeking financing, payroll, merchant services, software and professional support.

Business owners are pressed for time and often prefer a direct conversation to a lengthy online process, especially when seeking financing or switching a critical service like payroll or payment processing. Inbound Call programs place business services messaging in front of owners searching for solutions and invite them to call a specialist directly, complementing the web lead flow with decision makers ready to talk. Callers arrive with a defined need and basic facts about their business, enabling the specialist to qualify, quote and move toward an agreement on the first call. Delivery is scheduled to match business hours and sales team availability.

This product is suited to web leads businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of business services consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Owners, founders and operations leaders of small and mid-sized businesses across retail, restaurants, contracting, professional services, healthcare practices and e-commerce. The most valuable segments are established businesses with revenue seeking financing or processing services, growing companies adding employees and needing payroll or HR support, and new ventures forming an entity and setting up operations.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: searching for small business loans, merchant services or payroll services for small business; needs working capital for inventory, expansion or cash flow gaps; opening a new location or launching a business requiring formation and setup services; hiring employees and needing payroll, benefits or hr compliance support.
howGenerated: Calls are generated through call-only and click-to-call performance campaigns targeting searches such as "small business loans" and "business line of credit", alongside social and comparison placements. Every source is tracked, so call quality can be traced back to the campaign that produced it.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard business services criteria include: active or forming business located in the united states within the provider's coverage; business type, time in operation and approximate monthly revenue stated; specific service need identified, such as financing, processing, payroll or formation; owner or authorised decision maker confirmed; timeline for making a decision within the provider's target window; consent to be contacted captured and documented.
delivery: Calls are routed to your sales line in real time by state or ZIP, schedule and agent availability, with concurrency limits and daily caps set to your capacity. Call tracking and recording are available for quality control.

faq.q: Can business services leads be filtered by revenue and time in business?
faq.a: Yes. Monthly revenue, time in operation and business type are captured on every lead and can be used to filter delivery to the accounts your products are designed for.

faq.q: Which services can programs be built around?
faq.a: Programs can focus on business financing, merchant services, payroll and HR, business formation, accounting, telecom or a combination, with screening tailored to each.

faq.q: How do calls complement business services web leads?
faq.a: Web leads capture demand during research, while Inbound Calls and Live Transfers connect owners who want to talk immediately with your specialists, improving contact and close rates.
